name: Pipeliners - Work Report 2026-08-27
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-08-27

# Summary
Two work reports in Kim's format from Aug 26-27.

# Report 1: City page FAQ and CTA standardization
- **Problems:** 5 city pages had OTTO-injected FAQs; San Tan Valley's OTTO FAQ was hidden (`display:none`) while still emitting FAQPage schema for 30 questions; Litchfield Park's OTTO JSON-LD was malformed; the same 5 pages were on an old CTA.
- **Done:** audited all 37; extracted 48 Q&A pairs from Maricopa, Superior, Gold Canyon and Litchfield Park, removed 25 em dashes case by case, migrated them into the Elementor FAQ template; replaced OTTO custom_content with an HTML comment; rolled back San Tan Valley nlp_faq (reversible) and wrote a new 12-question FAQ grounded in published claims plus the verified EPCOR fact; swapped 5 CTAs to CTA Final V2.
- **Results:** all 37 city pages show a visible Elementor FAQ whose schema matches; zero OTTO FAQs remain; all 37 on CTA Final V2; phones untouched. Backups in `otto-faq-backup\`.
- **Pending then:** Kim to review the San Tan Valley FAQ; Scott to confirm "Pipeliners pulls the necessary permits" (now an approved claim as of Oct 1).

# Report 2: Internal linking
- **Problems:** see [Pipeliners - Internal Linking Plan 2026-08-27](lib:brain-pipeliners-internal-linking-plan-2026-08-27).
- **Done:** wrote the plan; built and then trashed (at Kim's instruction) a draft Service Areas hub, leaving live /services-areas/ untouched; audited Anthem; added 6-7 contextual links to every city page using phrases already in the copy; repointed the "root intrusion" anchor to the root intrusion guide.
- **Results:** /trenchless-drain-pipe-repair/ inbound links 35 to 74; /what-is-cipp/ 9 to 44; visible copy byte-identical (script-asserted); 0 nested or empty anchors. Corrected an earlier wrong statement that the "here!" links were OTTO-injected.
